claims.claim: The Estate Sale argues that when a company goes bankrupt, the law slows a sale of your data mainly if the company had promised not to transfer it.
We did not read the live policies directly; they change, so check the current text before relying on this.
We did not read the live policies directly; they change, so check the current text before relying on this. REPORTED
After 23andMe filed for bankruptcy, about 1.9 million customers asked for deletion before the sale.
Amazon's notice says transferred data stays subject to the promises in the earlier notice unless the customer agrees otherwise.
California, New York and Texas raised theirs in the 23andMe case, and lost.
